newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich acquires majority in Swiss Orion.
newsitem.headline: Zurich acquires majority in Swiss Orion.

text.p: Zurich Insurance Co said it had acquired 44 percent of the share capital of Orion Insurance, giving the Zurich group a majority stake.
Orion is a Basle-based company founded in 1976 that specialises in legal protection and coverage, Zurich said.
Zurich's susidiary, Geneva Insurance, already owns 12 percent of Orion.

The remaining minority shareholders, Swiss National Insurance Co. and Waadt Insurance Holding, have agreed with Zurich on a partnership concept along the lines of the existing cooperation to further exploit the opportunities in this specialist market.
Orion employs 52 people and had 1995 premium income of 14.5 million Swiss francs, a Zurich spokesman said.
